Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docx"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:import-memory","description":"Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. Asserting all 12 exist\n421\t * is the most direct proof the migration chain rebuilt the auth surface.\n422\t */\n423\tconst AUTH_BASELINE_TABLES = [\n424\t  'refresh_tokens',\n425\t  'webauthn_credentials',\n426\t  'user_module_assignments',\n427\t  'mobile_user_settings',\n428\t  'modules',\n429\t  'announcements',\n430\t  'announcement_acknowledgments',\n431\t  'message_threads',\n432\t  'messages',\n433\t  'support_tickets',\n434\t  'ticket_comments',\n435\t  'audit_logs',\n436\t];\n437\t\n438\t/**\n439\t * Dynamically load every migration class from a directory.\n440\t *\n441\t * Strategy: iterate the directory, filter to `<13-digit>-<Name>.ts` files\n442\t * (the codebase's enforced filename convention — see\n443\t * .github/workflows/db-migration-check.yml step \"Validate migration\n444\t * filename...\"), require each, and pull the default-or-named export\n445\t * whose name ends with the timestamp. Migration classes follow the\n446\t * convention `<Name><timestamp>` (e.g. `CreateInitialSchema1700000000000`).\n447\t */\n448\tfunction loadMigrationClassesFromDir(absDir: string): Array<new () => MigrationInterface> {\n449\t  // Wave 4-A.2 Dalga 5 — services that own a directory but ship no\n450\t  // migrations yet (config-service: .gitkeep only; gateway-api:\n451\t  // directory absent entirely) are valid manifest entries; return an\n452\t  // empty class list so the per-service runMigrations() call is a no-op\n453\t  // rather than a hard failure.\n454\t  if (!existsSync(absDir)) {\n455\t    return [];\n456\t  }\n457\t\n458\t  let entries: string[];\n459\t  try {\n460\t    entries = readdirSync(absDir);\n461\t  } catch (err) {\n462\t    throw new Error(\n463\t      `Migration directory ${absDir} could not be read: ${(err as Error).message}. ` +\n464\t        `Update SERVICES manifest if the path moved.`,\n465\t    );\n466\t  }\n467\t\n468\t  const migrationFiles = entries\n469\t    .filter((f) => /^[0-9]{13}-[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.ts$/.test(f))\n470\t    .filter((f) => !f.endsWith('.spec.ts') && !f.endsWith('.test.ts'))\n471\t    .sort(); // lexical sort = chronological because timestamps are zero-padded.\n472\t\n473\t  const classes: Array<new () => MigrationInterface> = [];\n474\t  for (const file of migrationFiles) {\n475\t    const fullPath = join(absDir, file);\n476\t    if (!statSync(fullPath).isFile()) continue;\n477\t\n478\t    // ts-jest transforms .ts files when loaded through requireModule here\n479\t    // because this spec runs under the ts-jest transform configured in\n480\t    // e2e/jest.config.ts. Each migration's `export class <Name>` becomes\n481\t    // a property on the loaded module object.\n482\t    const mod = requireModule(fullPath) as Record<string, unknown>;\n483\t    const candidate = Object.values(mod).find(\n484\t      (v): v is new () => MigrationInterface =>\n485\t        typeof v === 'function' && /^[A-Z]/.test(v.name) && /\\d{13}$/.test(v.name),\n486\t    );\n487\t    if (!candidate) {\n488\t      throw new Error(\n489\t        `Migration file ${fullPath} did not export a class whose name matches ` +\n490\t          `<PascalCaseName><13-digit-timestamp>. Filename + class-name convention ` +\n491\t          `is enforced by .github/workflows/db-migration-check.yml.`,\n492\t      );\n493\t    }\n494\t    classes.push(candidate);\n495\t  }\n496\t  return classes;\n497\t}\n498\t\n499\t/**"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"433f0f65-1360-4acc-a9a4-5ebb4f35950f","uuid":"ea8e4d60-5770-4f9d-aac3-75e766143ded","timestamp":"2026-09-19T23:04:36.596Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-0e133e6b6a33/apps/db-migrate/src/__tests__/bootstrap-from-scratch.spec.ts","content":"\n/**\n * Schemas that MUST exist after the init scripts have run, BEFORE any\n * TypeORM migration touches the DB.
